summary: Leg (d) is a hard, source-confirmed break: super-productivity v2.13.15 has NO dark-theme UI control (isDarkMode formly field commented out; /project-settings offers only primary/accent/warn colors), so 'toggle dark theme via the project-settings formly save' cannot be driven — matching the packet's own leg-d blocked clause. Legs (c)/(b) are drivable and I confirmed migrated dist-25 is clean (pageErrors 0) with all selectors resolving, but the live c+b drive hung on add-task-bar-input after the reload and captured no readings, so c+b are unmeasured and I will not pin guessed values. Extended the calibrate driver (dist-25 rebind + c+b probes) in-contract; tsc green. Blocking for a leg-d decision and a c+b re-cut.
open_questions: Leg (d): how should it be re-specified? In v2.13.15 there is no dark-theme UI control (isDarkMode formly field is commented out at misc-settings-form.const.ts:12; project-form-cfg.const.ts has only color fields). Options: (a) keep project-switch (side-nav addProject dialog + switchProject) and a keyboard shortcut (w/b), and replace the dark-theme probe with a /project-settings formly PRIMARY/ACCENT color change (real formly config-section save that does produce a rendered-style shift via --palette-* custom properties); or (b) drive dark theme by seeding persisted config misc.isDarkMode=true (not a UI formly save) and probe the .isDarkTheme class + background-color; or (c) drop leg (d) from this vertical. This decision is missing from the packet and I will not improvise a substitute.

Leg (b) drag correction to confirm in the re-cut: the reorder must be initiated on 'task .drag-handle.handle-par' (container '.task-list-inner', dragula group PARENT), not the whole 'task' element — the work-view group 'moves' callback restricts drag-start to the handle class. The jira-clone card-grab precedent will not start this drag.

Legs (c)/(b) need one more calibration pass to reach measured-green before pinning: the migrated dist-25 c+b drive hung 30s on 'add-task-bar input' when creating the SECOND task after page.reload() (the initial-load create worked). Is this a real after-reload/SW-served add-task-bar behavior on the migrated lane (a RED to record), or just a settle-timing issue in my probe? It must be resolved and c+b measured on BOTH lanes before the values are pinned into WITNESS_ANGULAR_SUPER_PRODUCTIVITY_JOURNEY. Suggested re-cut: drive legs c+b BEFORE the leg-(e) reload (where add-task-bar is known-good) rather than after it.

Schema note for the re-cut: WitnessAngularSuperProductivityJourney has drag?/timeTracking? shapes already (from commit 3d68c5f) but NO leg-(d) project-switch/theme field; leg (d) will need a new schema shape wherever it lands.
